title: Philip IV → the marquis of Velada, ambassador extraordinary in England: two short cipher runs
correspondents: Philip IV of Spain (countersigned Andrés de Rozas) → Antonio Sancho Dávila, marquis of Velada

folio_note: 7 scans (KHA image ids 96169-96174); two cipher runs of about 20 and 25 groups, both ending '121 so ta na te 6 Q X'
status: Viewed 25 Oct 2026: clear Spanish recalling Velada to Flanders, with two short cipher runs (figures 4-171, signs, syllables), no decipherment, nothing on the dorse, no print found. Too short for a break; needs the 1640 Velada/Malvezzi cifra (Simancas, Estado, Inglaterra).
why: The cipher runs are the secret part of the order recalling Velada from London in the year of the Catalan and Portuguese revolts.
